title: 实现 Transfer/Operation 沙箱闭环
risks: No production durable filesystem/NAS adapter, operation or transfer store, database journal, composition root, API, worker, permission entry point or audit integration is included; this is a test-only sandbox slice and production writes remain disabled.

The in-memory test stores and relative sandbox journal validate idempotent recovery semantics but do not prove production database transactions, cross-process locks, multi-node fencing or power-loss durability.
Cross-volume, real NAS/SMB, non-cooperative external changes, ACL combinations, critical disk-space behavior and 1/20/100 GiB release profiles still require separately approved tasks.
M0-006-G1, M0-006-G2 and M0-006-G3 remain open; their evidence and approvals are mandatory before any production physical-write path can be enabled.

architecture_review.module: TransferSync and OperationTrash domain/application contracts with test-only bounded physical sandbox adapters
reused_existing_logic: M0-006 physical-facts-first, complete SHA-256, no-replace, source-preserving conflict and idempotent recovery evidence
V01-004/V01-005 .NET value-object, explicit-state, application-port, cancellation/deadline and privacy-safe structured-log patterns
The frozen canonical operation-plan schema as read-only design input; its file and digest remain unchanged
Existing solution, dependency, source, repository, architecture, SDK, database, Web and release-gate verification graph
duplicated_logic: Physical length/hash and no-replace invariants are intentionally rechecked at preflight, commit and recovery trust/time boundaries; shared sandbox primitives remove same-layer duplication while each boundary independently fails closed.
cross_module_access: OperationTrash references only public TransferSync.Contracts token and physical-fact value types; neither module references the other's Infrastructure or internal entities.
All filesystem, hashing, journal, fault-injection and recovery adapters live only in AssetLibrary.TransferOperation.Tests and are absent from production composition.
Canonical contracts, database migrations, GatewayAuth, LibraryStorage, AssetIdentity, ScanReconciliation, TaskHealth and generated SDK sources are unchanged.
Production source is guarded against V01-007 sandbox paths, disk-write APIs, test adapter types and physical-write enablement switches.
contract_changes: TransferSync adds module-owned C# contracts for opaque path tokens, strong physical facts, bounded sessions, progress and stable failure/result semantics.
OperationTrash adds module-owned C# contracts for bounded plans, preflight/confirmation binding, execution rights, per-item results and recovery evidence.
The canonical operation JSON schema remains unchanged at SHA-256 f2e29c8c750032409b69056cb0e8fe1733135d3b4eea5e9ac238956872575f7e; there are no wire, database or SDK changes.
architecture_tests: 64 targeted TransferOperation MSTest cases and the complete 167-test .NET solution, locked restore, format, Release build, dependency/source policy and vulnerability report
53 required database tests including 14 PostgreSQL 16.15 integration cases, plus 42 repository and 14 architecture tests
14 generated-SDK Python and 21 AssetLink contract/spike tests, TypeScript SDK 5/5, Kotlin/JVM build, Web frozen-install/audit/build and 6 Chromium regressions
Repository verifier, production-composition negative scans, handoff validation, v0.1-start allow gate and expected production-file-writes/v0.1-release deny gates
Sandbox cleanup verification: zero fixture-* directories, zero Python cache directories and zero related task processes
technical_debt: Design a separately owned production durable adapter and operation/transfer persistence task with database-backed journal, cross-process locks, fencing and crash consistency.
Integrate unified permission, protection, preflight, audit and trash policy only through approved core ports before exposing any API, worker or UI write entry point.
Run cross-volume, real NAS/SMB, non-cooperative writer, ACL, disk-space, power-loss and release rollback/recovery exercises.
Complete and approve M0-006-G1/G2/G3, including 1/20/100 GiB and representative scale evidence, before production physical writes can leave the default-off state.
